blind.description: A metal bear trap / foothold trap lying open on the ground. It features two curved semicircular jaws lined with sharp triangular teeth, a central circular pressure plate trigger mounted on a crossbar base mechanism, and a short heavy iron chain attached to one side. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and textured with weathered dark iron/steel, resting flat directly on the floor with no plinth.
blind.from_above: A rounded oval or circular open trap with inward-facing spiked teeth on both sides, a round center trigger disc bisected by a straight bar, and a short segmented chain extending to the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: It sits extremely low to the ground, only a few inches high (roughly 1/20th of the figure's height), with a jaw diameter of approximately 1.5 to 2 feet wide.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
